prior_to_rotation: Confirm extra duty assignment type with chief resident or program coordinator

logistics: Clarify supervision chain and who to page for clinical questions

Autonomy or escalation moment — when you sought help or led
Teaching or administrative contribution worth portfolio capture
Would you volunteer for similar duty again — why or why not?
